name: scapula dips
description: A bench-supported scapular dip that moves the shoulders while keeping the arms straight.
instructions: Sit at the front edge of a sturdy bench and place your hands beside or slightly behind your hips.
Straighten your arms and move your hips just off the bench, keeping your feet planted.
Without bending your elbows, let your shoulders rise slightly as your body lowers.
Press the bench down to depress your shoulder blades and lift your body a short distance, then repeat.
